headline: 13-Year-Old Genius Overcomes Cancer and Bullying to Enter Grad School
meta_description: A 13-year-old with genius-level IQ is preparing to start graduate school after battling cancer and severe bullying.
summary_short: A 13-year-old with genius-level intelligence is set to begin graduate school next year, having survived both cancer and severe bullying.
body:
A 13-year-old with genius-level IQ is preparing to start graduate school next year—a milestone that comes after the young student survived both cancer and severe bullying.

The journey reflects remarkable resilience. While many teenagers are navigating high school, this student will soon enter the world of advanced academic research and study. The combination of exceptional intellectual ability and the strength to overcome serious health challenges and social adversity paints a picture of determination beyond typical peer experience.

Stories like this remind us that intelligence alone doesn't guarantee an easy path—young people of exceptional ability often face unique pressures, including social isolation and bullying. Yet this teenager's trajectory toward graduate study demonstrates that with support and perseverance, even the most difficult obstacles can be overcome.
